title: ATV Optimizer
shortDescription: Manage apps, run diagnostics and tune your Android TV over wireless debugging.
fullDescription:
Manage your Android TV or Google TV from your phone over Wi-Fi, with no computer needed. ATV Optimizer connects through debugging that you enable and authorize on your own TV.

Start with Free
• Check whether your TV connects before buying Pro
• View installed apps, storage and diagnostics
• Use your phone as a remote
• Re-enable disabled apps and run Emergency recovery, even without Pro

Optional Pro features
• Disable or uninstall apps you don't use, with protected-app checks and risk warnings
• Review and apply an Optimize plan
• Change your Home app and, where the TV firmware allows, disable the stock launcher after confirmation
• Adjust TV settings such as HDMI-CEC, display scaling and Private DNS
• Save snapshots and preview changes before applying them

Pro is a one-time Google Play purchase with no subscription. Undoing settings, Home app or snapshot changes requires Pro. Emergency recovery re-enables disabled apps; it doesn't reverse every setting.

What you need
• An Android TV or Google TV on the same local network as your phone
• Developer options and Network debugging or Wireless debugging enabled on the TV
• Your approval on the TV's debugging prompt

Support varies by TV and firmware. Some manufacturers protect the stock launcher or other apps, so not every change works on every TV. Fire TV isn't supported.

Changing system apps can affect how your TV behaves. Read the warnings, review every plan and change only what you understand.

Privacy
Saved TVs, installed-app lists, snapshots, screenshots and downloaded files stay on your phone or local network. Optional device and error reports are on by default, with a notice and an opt-out in More → Privacy. Reports include TV model, software versions, a random installation ID, action outcomes and redacted errors. They don't include TV serial numbers, network addresses, TV names or installed-app lists. See the privacy policy in the app for retention and deletion details.
